apple.definition: A round fruit with firm flesh and red, green, or yellow skin.

banana.definition: A long, curved fruit with yellow skin and soft, sweet flesh.

orange.definition: A round citrus fruit with orange skin and juicy sections inside.

grape.definition: A small, round fruit that grows in bunches and can be green or purple.

strawberry.definition: A small red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface.

watermelon.definition: A large fruit with green skin, red or yellow flesh, and many seeds.

pineapple.definition: A large tropical fruit with rough skin, yellow flesh, and pointed leaves.

mango.definition: A sweet tropical fruit with yellow-orange flesh and one large seed.

peach.definition: A soft, sweet fruit with fuzzy skin and one large stone inside.

pear.definition: A sweet fruit with a narrow top and rounded bottom.

blueberry.definition: A small round blue or purple fruit that grows on a bush.

raspberry.definition: A soft red berry that grows on a bush.

blackberry.definition: A soft, dark-purple berry made of many small juicy parts.

cranberry.definition: A small, tart red berry often used in juice or sauce.

gooseberry.definition: A small green or red berry with a tart taste, often used in jam.

mulberry.definition: A small, sweet berry that grows on a tree and can be red, purple, or black.

boysenberry.definition: A large, dark berry related to blackberries and raspberries.

acai-berry.definition: A small dark-purple fruit from a South American palm, often processed into pulp or puree.
acai-berry.exampleUsage: Açaí berry pulp is used in some fruit dishes.

lingonberry.definition: A small, tart red berry that grows on low plants in northern regions.

elderberry.definition: A small, dark berry from the elder tree, often cooked into syrup or jam.

papaya.definition: A tropical fruit with yellow-orange skin, orange flesh, and black seeds.

coconut.definition: A large brown fruit with a hard shell, white flesh, and liquid inside.

passion-fruit.definition: A round tropical fruit with a tough skin and fragrant, seedy pulp inside.

guava.definition: A round tropical fruit with green or yellow skin and fragrant flesh.

lychee.definition: A small fruit with rough red skin, sweet white flesh, and one seed.

dragon-fruit.definition: A tropical cactus fruit with bright skin and white, pink, or red flesh containing many small black seeds.
dragon-fruit.exampleUsage: The dragon fruit was cut open to show its speckled flesh.

star-fruit.definition: A yellow tropical fruit whose slices look like stars.

jackfruit.definition: A very large tropical fruit with a rough skin and sweet yellow pieces inside.

durian.definition: A large tropical fruit with a spiky shell and strong-smelling flesh.

rambutan.definition: A small tropical fruit with a red hairy skin and sweet white flesh.

lemon.definition: A yellow citrus fruit with sour juice.

lime.definition: A small green citrus fruit with sour juice.

grapefruit.definition: A large citrus fruit with a thick rind and tart pink or yellow flesh.

tangerine.definition: A small orange citrus fruit with sweet flesh and easy-to-peel skin.

mandarin.definition: A small sweet citrus fruit with a loose, easy-to-peel orange skin.

clementine.definition: A small, sweet type of mandarin orange with thin, easy-to-peel skin.

kumquat.definition: A small orange citrus fruit that can be eaten with its sweet peel.

blood-orange.definition: A type of orange with red or dark-red flesh inside.
blood-orange.exampleUsage: The blood orange had dark red flesh.

pomelo.definition: A very large citrus fruit with thick skin and pale, mildly sweet sections.

yuzu.definition: A fragrant East Asian citrus fruit with yellow or green skin and a tart flavor.
yuzu.exampleUsage: Yuzu peel has a strong citrus aroma.

cherry.definition: A small, round fruit with red or dark skin and one hard stone inside.

plum.definition: A small, smooth-skinned fruit with sweet flesh and one stone inside.

apricot.definition: A small orange fruit with soft skin, sweet flesh, and one stone inside.

nectarine.definition: A sweet fruit like a peach but with smooth skin.

date.definition: A small, sweet brown fruit that grows on a palm tree.

fig.definition: A soft fruit with thin skin and many tiny seeds inside.

olive.definition: A small green or black fruit often eaten after curing or pressed for oil.

avocado.definition: A fruit with green flesh, thick skin, and one large seed.

persimmon.definition: A sweet orange fruit with smooth skin and soft flesh when ripe.

pomegranate.definition: A round fruit with a thick skin and many juicy red seeds inside.
